usedFor: flowyteam tracks goals and key results, and Google Drive shares a file after “New Off-Track Key Result” through “Share File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A key result going off track gives a chosen person or anyone access to your review file.

watchOut: “Share File” grants Viewer, Commenter or Editor access, so set the level deliberately before “New Check-in” runs.
